data_availability_text: Data availabilityMetabolomics data used in this study for the discovery cohort have been deposited in the Metabolomics Workbench (https://www.metabolomicsworkbench.org/data/DRCCMetadata.php?Mode=Project&ProjectID=PR002674) under Project ID PR002674. Requests for other data and materials will be reviewed by the cohort, and contact PIs Dr. Jessica Lasky-Su at rejas@channing.harvard.edu for the studies to determine if the request is subject to intellectual property or confidentiality obligations. We anticipate responding to requests within approximately 2–4 weeks. Data and materials that can be shared will be released using a Material Transfer Agreement. Appropriate IRB approvals may be required to access de-identified data, in particular, data from electronic medical health records.
